title: Backport golang-1.26 1.26.8-1 to noble (LP: #2166409).
description:
Backport golang-1.26 1.26.8-1 to noble (LP: #2166409).

No control changes needed: the golang-1.25-go | golang-1.24-go Build-Depends alternative resolves to golang-1.24-go in noble. NOTE: go1.26.8 requires bootstrap >= go1.24.6 (src/cmd/dist/buildtool.go), so the PPA build for noble must wait until golang-1.24 1.24.13 (LP: #2164608) is released to -updates/-security; noble currently ships 1.24.4.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 3daab94..0144acc 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+golang-1.26 (1.26.8-1~24.04.1) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * Backport golang-1.26 1.26.8-1 to noble (LP: #2166409).
+    - Build bootstraps from golang-1.24-go, which satisfies the upstream
+      minimum bootstrap version (go1.24.6) as of golang-1.24 1.24.13.
+
+ -- Anshul Singh <anshul.singh@canonical.com>  Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:55:04 +0530
+
 golang-1.26 (1.26.8-1) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream version 1.26.8
